capabilities.name: Database Persistence
capabilities.description: Apply schema changes and upsert vendor records to Supabase cs_vendors table.
verification_patterns: run scripts/check_supabase.py and confirm no missing columns
run a vendor upsert and confirm HTTP 201 or 200

capabilities.name: Data Pipeline
capabilities.description: Run the CSP vendor discovery, enrichment, and persistence pipeline.
verification_patterns: run scripts/run_pipeline.py and confirm vendors in Supabase

capabilities.name: LLM Extraction

verification_patterns: run scripts/run_pipeline.py --limit 5 and confirm lifecycle_stages, use_cases, icp_buyer populated
